text:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — the mini Next + LangChain sample kit is failing end-to-end when run as an edge SSR build.
Maria: Steps to repro?
Jordan: Clone repo, npm ci, build with next edge runtime, then run eval harness. In dev (node) everything looks fine, but on edge the eval harness fails and telemetry events don't show up in the dashboard.
Sam: Which Next/runtime and sdk versions?
Jordan: next@13.5, @redwood/sdk 0.8.1, using edge runtime on Vercel.
Piotr: Can you paste the failing error snippet?
Jordan: Sure — short stack:
```
Error: Eval harness: missing telemetry key
    at evalRunner (/app/eval/runner.js:42:13)
    at processEdgeRequest (edge-handler.js:88:7)
```
Maria: Hmm — sounds like SDK init didn't finish before the harness started. On node we call init in a server module that persists, but edge can cold start per request.
Jordan: I tried moving init into the route handler so it's synchronous, still no telemetry. Also auth behaves weird: token refresh appears to happen but first request after refresh returns 401, then retry succeeds.
Tiago: That pattern often points to timers/polyfills — backoff/retry logic uses setTimeout so on some edge runtimes it gets dropped.
Sam: Is fetch polyfilled by Next edge? The SDK backoff uses setTimeout and globalThis.setTimeout. Edge runtimes sometimes don't provide that in the same way.
Jordan: Right. I logged globalThis.setTimeout === undefined on the bundled edge function in our build.
Piotr: Workaround: switch to server runtime (node) and the eval harness passes. Not great for customers who want edge demos.
Maria: I'll open an SDK PR to guard timers — use a small inline fallback that uses MessageChannel or synchronous retries when no timers available, and ensure init flushes telemetry on request end for edge.
Jordan: Posting a minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-repro/abcd1234 (contains dockerfile + next config + harness).
devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-879: "mini-next-langchain edge SSR telemetry + auth retry" assigned to @Maria.
Tiago: If you can, @Jordan add the build logs and the exact bundle snapshot to the ticket — will help root cause.
Jordan: Added logs + bundle listing. Also includes small snippet that breaks:
```js
// edge handler
import { init } from '@redwood/sdk'
export default async function handler(req) {
  init({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
  // eval harness call
  return await runEval(req.body)
}
```
Maria: Thanks — looks like we need to make init idempotent+async-safe on edge. I'll draft fix + unit test in the SDK repo.
Sam: I can mirror the PR into the samplekit to change the example to call await init(...) before running the harness so customers see the correct pattern.
Jordan: Appreciate it. Will smoke test on Vercel once PR is up.
Maria: ETA for PR today EOD.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
